#house #outside

Did the front and back gutters 2 Nov 2024 after the downpipe by the back door started overflowing onto the patio and the wall got a green streak. Front is easy off the 3.9m extension ladder with a stand-off so it doesn't sit on the plastic. Back is the awkward one, over the kitchen roof, had to go from the flat roof with a kneeling board. Got about 3 buckets of sludge, moss and a tennis ball (not ours) out of the back run. Gutter is old cast iron at the back, Marley plastic at the front. Hosed through after: front fine, back downpipe still slow, rodded it from the bottom with the drain rods and a 100mm plunger head and a clump of moss and leaves shot out. One joint on the back run drips, needs a new union clip (Marley RUC2, about £6) next dry weekend. Neighbour Pete at 41 shares the gutter at the front so split the time 50/50. Do it every November now, before the winter rain. Related: [[Damp in the bathroom]] (the back wall damp was partly this), [[Flood insurance]].
